# appgatesdp_client_profile_group (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) A name to identify the client profile. It will appear on the client UI.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `profile_urls` (Attributes List) List of Client Profile URLs in this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profile_urls))
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--profile_urls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profile_urls`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Hostname parsed from the given URL.
- `id` (String) Identifier to track the object on update since all the other fields are write-only. A random one will be assigned if left empty.
- `profile_name` (String) Profile name parsed from the given URL.
- `url` (String) Appgate URL exported from Client Profiles. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `weight` (Number) Load balancing weight of the profile in this group.
